name: Balaclava
description: Black knitted balaclava. Keeps the wind off and your face out of photos. Stops nothing.

name: Shemagh
description: Cotton scarf wrapped over the nose and mouth against dust. Stops nothing.

name: Half-face respirator
description: Rubber half mask with twin filters, from a paint shop. Breathing is easier in the dust; bullets don't care.

name: Shchit ballistic mask
description: Aramid and polyethylene mask molded to the face. Class 3 over the face, worn with or without a helmet.

name: Kremen-4 steel mask
description: Heavy steel face plate on a padded harness. Class 4 over the face; hard to hear through.
